hints.title: Value Grouping
hints.text: Group indices by identical values so that each group can be evaluated independently.

hints.title: Sorted Index Properties
hints.text: Within each value group, indices are naturally strictly ascending: i0 < i1 < i2 < ... < im-1.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Difference Formula
hints.text: For index i_r at rank r in a group, the sum of distances is (r * i_r - sum_left) + (sum_right - (m - 1 - r) * i_r).

hints.title: Prefix Sum Distance Accumulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Group indices in O(n) and compute prefix distances per group in O(group_size).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise distance sum across all identical pairs takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for grouping dictionary and prefix lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups indices by value and computes distance sums using prefix arrays.
